overview_description.description: Humand is a company that provides a software platform that centralizes internal communication, human resources management, company culture, talent development, and related operations in a single digital environment. It offers tools for managing employee interactions, workflows, HR processes, onboarding, surveys, time tracking, internal social networking, and organizational information through a unified app interface. The platform is designed to create a digital community that connects all employees and streamlines routine tasks for administrative teams. Its services support customization of features based on organizational needs and integrate with other systems to facilitate secure access and workflow continuity.
